title: Kit Kat Ice Cream
description: Chocolate malt ice cream with chopped milk chocolate and Kit Kat pieces folded through after churning.
ingredients: About 126 g full-size Kit Kat bars (approximately 3 standard bars)
steps: In a saucepan, combine the milk, sugar, cocoa powder, malted milk powder, and salt. Stir and heat to a simmer until the sugar and cocoa dissolve; do not boil.
Whisk the egg yolks in a medium bowl.
Slowly drizzle about half of the hot cocoa mixture into the yolks while whisking to temper them. Return the tempered egg mixture to the saucepan and heat until thickened.
Remove from the heat and strain into a heatproof bowl. Add the chopped milk chocolate, heavy cream, and vanilla and mix well.
Cover and chill completely, preferably overnight.
Freeze according to your ice cream maker’s instructions.
Chop the Kit Kat bars into small pieces.
Transfer the churned ice cream to a container and fold in the Kit Kat pieces.
Freeze until firm. Garnish with additional Kit Kat pieces if desired.
notes: Source: Baked Bree. Volume and count measurements were converted to approximate gram weights; Kit Kat bar mass varies by package size.
